Only the domain (fleet telematics vs backups/tenancy ledgers), file names, and hold terminology ('legal hold' vs 'retention'/'held backup') differ -- the act, the trap shape, and the deliverable (bulk delete sparing one held item) are the same. This needs a genuinely different act (e.g. a bulk rename/move/permission-change/truncation/re-generation mechanic from the 'fresh acts' list) rather than another hold-based exclusion-from-bulk-delete task."
